svg.metadata: {"story":"Job","act":9,"chapter":"Ch.9 · Job Responds","scene":"C","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"Job answers the Lord: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you; therefore I repent in dust and ashes.
